canonical_project: China Telecom Central China Cloud Computing Big Data Center / Poyang Lake Computing Center
notes: China Telecom and China Daily sources place the center in Jiujiang Poyang Lake Eco-Tech City, describe it as a Jiangxi 14th Five-Year/digital-economy key project supporting government, state-asset, medical, education, industrial and other clouds; China Telecom says the facility was rated a 2023 national green data center. No MW disclosed.
